epics.title: Academic Entity Relationship Knowledge Graph & Profile Cards
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, department head, or supervisor manages academic workflows, I want an entity relationship graph connecting postgraduates, residents, applicants, academic supervisors, departments, commissions, and their official documents, so that academic profiles, institutional hierarchy, and document provenance are transparently organized and navigable.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Entity-document relationship retrieval latency < 35ms with 100% referential integrity across academic entities
epics.tocConstraintRef: Relational schema bottleneck between multi-role academic entities and generated document associations
requirements: R1: Define relational and graph data models for academic entities: postgraduates, residents, applicants, academic supervisors, departments, and examination/admission commissions
R2: Implement data persistence and bidirectional association indexing linking official documents to respective entity cards and departmental hierarchies
R3: Expose RESTful API endpoints for entity CRUD, relational traversal, document-link querying, and academic directory filtering
R4: Build responsive academic entity directory and detail card views adhering to strict academic aesthetic without emojis or informal pictograms with WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
R5: Validate comprehensive test pyramid spanning entity relationship graph integrity, document linkage consistency, and directory navigation

slices.title: Academic Entity Graph Relational Schema & Migration Definition
slices.jtbd: When implementing the data model for this epic, I want structured schema definitions for academic entities and document link tables, so that postgraduates, residents, supervisors, departments, and commissions maintain strict referential integrity.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an academic database migration script, When executed against the PostgreSQL database, Then tables for academic_entities, supervisors, departments, commissions, and entity_document_links are created with appropriate foreign keys and indices.
Given an entity card record, When a document link is attached, Then bidirectional lookups between entity ID and document reference resolve in under 15ms.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero foreign key orphan violations on cascading entity-document associations

slices.title: Academic Entity Graph API Contract Specification
slices.jtbd: When establishing shared client-server contracts for this epic, I want OpenAPI specifications for entity graph endpoints and document attachments, so that frontend components and backend services build asynchronously against stable DTOs.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the OpenAPI schema for entity directory and cards, When validated with openapi-generator, Then all request and response schemas for postgraduates, residents, supervisors, and commissions compile without contract errors.
Given an entity card lookup request specification, When inspected, Then pagination, sorting, and linked document collection DTOs are explicitly defined.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Shared API contract synchronization between frontend and backend
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% schema alignment between Java Spring backend controllers and TypeScript client definitions

slices.title: Academic Entity REST Controller & Graph Service Implementation
slices.jtbd: When developing backend services for this epic, I want Spring Boot controllers and graph querying services, so that frontend clients can query, filter, and associate academic entity cards with documents.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a GET request to /api/v1/entities with role filter 'resident', When executed by an authorized administrator, Then HTTP 200 is returned with a paginated list of resident entity cards and their linked departments.
Given a POST request to /api/v1/entities/{id}/documents with document metadata, When executed, Then the association is persisted and HTTP 201 is returned.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Backend service throughput for entity graph navigation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Sub-40ms response time on multi-hop entity-department-document queries

slices.title: High-Academic Entity Directory & Profile Cards UI
slices.jtbd: When building user interfaces for this epic, I want an academic directory and profile card view free of informal emojis and compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA, so that educational stakeholders inspect entity dossiers with dignified institutional styling.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an administrator viewing the academic directory on desktop or mobile, When browsing postgraduate, resident, supervisor, and commission cards, Then typography uses austere institutional styling with no emojis or casual pictograms and contrast ratio >= 4.5:1.
Given an entity card view, When the associated documents tab is selected, Then all linked official orders and certifications are rendered with accessible keyboard focus and download links.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Frontend rendering latency for dense academic relationship tables
slices.sixSigmaMetric: WCAG 2.1 AA 100% audit pass rate and zero emoji/informal icon violations in academic UI

slices.title: Academic Entity Graph & Card Navigation Test Suite
slices.jtbd: When verifying quality for this epic, I want unit, integration, and E2E test suites covering entity graph traversal, document associations, and UI accessibility, so that regressions in academic data relationships are prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for EntityGraphService, When executed with mock repository data, Then entity-to-document associations and hierarchy cascades pass all assertions.
Given an end-to-end Playwright test navigating from a department view to a supervisor card and inspecting linked docx documents, When executed on mobile and desktop viewports, Then all DOM elements are accessible and navigation completes under 2.5 seconds.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Regression test suite coverage across academic hierarchy flows
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test passing rate across entity graph unit, integration, and UI acceptance scenarios

requirements: R1: Implement autonomous agent orchestration allowing multi-step reasoning to ingest administrative intent, resolve entity context, and trigger official docx generation
R2: Implement official GOST R 7.0.97-2016 .docx document generation engine with pre-validation of mandatory administrative attributes, signatures, and organizational stamps
R3: Automatically associate generated docx documents with target academic entity cards in the entity graph repository upon issuance
R4: Implement formal document validation rules asserting document schema conformity, required legal seals, and institutional nomenclature before dispatch
R5: Build formal administrative prompt interface in high academic styling without smileys or decorative emojis, displaying agent validation telemetry
R6: Verify autonomous docx generation, schema validation, and entity attachment through complete test pyramid

slices.title: Autonomous Agent Document Orchestrator & Reasoning Pipeline
slices.jtbd: When implementing autonomous agent capabilities for this epic, I want an agentic workflow pipeline that parses regulatory administrative prompts and binds entity context, so that formal documents are synthesized reliably.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an administrative request to draft an admission commission order for postgraduate applicants, When processed by the agent pipeline, Then the agent resolves required entity IDs and constructs a normalized document synthesis plan.
Given ambiguous or incomplete entity parameters, When evaluated by the agent guardrails, Then clarification requests are formulated in formal academic tone without hallucinatory defaults.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Agent reasoning reliability and contextual entity extraction precision
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Document synthesis intent extraction accuracy >= 99.2% on administrative prompts

slices.title: GOST R 7.0.97-2016 Document Generator & Schema Validator
slices.jtbd: When building official document synthesis for this epic, I want a docx generation engine with pre-validation against GOST R 7.0.97-2016 requisites, so that produced documents meet institutional legal standards.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a structured document payload with order metadata, When processed by the docx generator, Then a valid .docx file matching GOST R 7.0.97-2016 layout (margins, fonts, seals, signatory blocks) is compiled.
Given a generated docx file lacking mandatory registration indices or department signatories, When passed to the validator, Then validation errors are flagged and generation is halted before persistence.
slices.tocConstraintRef: DOCX document compilation and GOST typographical validation fidelity
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% compliance with GOST R 7.0.97-2016 administrative document validation rules

slices.title: Entity Card Document Linkage & Storage Integration
slices.jtbd: When persisting agent-generated documents for this epic, I want automatic metadata storage and entity graph association, so that generated official orders immediately reflect on target entity cards.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a successfully validated administrative docx order for a resident or supervisor, When stored via the document persistence service, Then a permanent storage key is generated and linked to the target entity card IDs.
Given an entity card document query, When retrieved, Then the newly generated docx order appears in the entity's official document dossier.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Entity-document transactional linkage and metadata persistence
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero dropped document-to-entity links on concurrent agent generation requests

slices.title: Academic Agent Console & Document Inspection Interface
slices.jtbd: When creating the operator interface for this epic, I want a dignified academic agent console free of emojis with docx preview and validation telemetry, so that educational administrators command agent generation securely.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an administrator accessing the AI assistant console, When prompting for order generation, Then the interface renders in high academic styling with no emojis or smileys and clear progress indicators.
Given a generated document awaiting approval, When displayed in the console, Then validation status badges, GOST compliance checklist, and one-click docx download controls are accessible with keyboard navigation.
slices.tocConstraintRef: User interface responsiveness during asynchronous agent document generation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with zero informal emoji elements across agent views

slices.title: Agent Document Generation & Validation Test Pyramid Suite
slices.jtbd: When asserting reliability for this epic, I want comprehensive unit, integration, and E2E verification of agent generation, docx formatting, and entity linking, so that administrative document integrity is guaranteed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for the docx generator and GOST validator, When tested with diverse administrative templates, Then all required XML attributes and formatting rules pass verification.
Given an end-to-end integration test requesting an official order for an applicant, When executed, Then the agent creates the docx, validates its structure, links it to the applicant card, and serves the downloadable asset within 4 seconds.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Verification execution time across multi-stage agent document workflows
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% automated test passing rate across document generation and validation suites

epics.title: Academic Multi-Format Analytics Reporting & Contingent Progress Engine
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, department head, or supervisor evaluates academic operations, I want to generate spreadsheet reports (XLSX, CSV) and summary analytical dossiers on postgraduates, residents, faculty teaching workload, and individual curriculum plan execution, so that institutional reporting and contingent progress analysis are automated with high numerical fidelity.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Report compilation time < 1.5s for 10,000 student-course contingent records with zero calculation discrepancies
epics.tocConstraintRef: Multi-format tabular serialization throughput and aggregation compute bottlenecks for contingent records
requirements: R1: Define analytical data aggregation models for postgraduates, residents, supervisor teaching workload balance, and individual curriculum plan (IP) progress tracking
R2: Implement high-performance tabular reporting engine supporting dynamic streaming export to XLSX and CSV formats with standardized institutional headers
R3: Build analytical summary report generation service computing contingent KPIs, academic debt, supervisor capacity, and milestone fulfillment rates
R4: Expose REST API contract and endpoints for generating, filtering, scheduling, and downloading multi-format analytical reports
R5: Develop responsive academic analytics dashboard with interactive data grid, filter controls, and tabular export actions in high academic styling
R6: Provide full test pyramid verification spanning tabular calculation accuracy, XLSX/CSV structural validity, and reporting API performance

slices.title: Academic Contingent & Workload Analytics Data Aggregation Models
slices.jtbd: When designing analytical schemas for this epic, I want query models aggregating contingent enrollment, academic progress, supervisor workload, and individual plan completion, so that reporting calculations run efficiently.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given academic database tables for residents, postgraduates, and curriculum plans, When executing analytical aggregation queries, Then student progress percentages and supervisor workload ratios are calculated with zero null-pointer anomalies.
Given a dataset of 5,000 academic plans, When aggregated by department and academic year, Then query execution finishes in under 200ms.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Analytical database aggregation query efficiency across contingent tables
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero precision loss in aggregated academic workload hours and completion percentages

slices.title: Reporting API Specification & Shared DTO Contract
slices.jtbd: When standardizing analytics endpoints for this epic, I want an OpenAPI specification defining report query parameters, analytical summary schemas, and export formats, so that frontend components and export workers build against stable contracts.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the OpenAPI contract definition for /api/v1/reports/contingent and /api/v1/reports/workload, When validated, Then export format query parameters (xlsx, csv) and filter DTOs compile cleanly.
Given report generation response schemas, When inspected, Then summary metrics (total students, completed plans, overloaded supervisors) are strictly typed.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Shared API contract synchronization for tabular export and analytics payloads
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% schema compliance between report generator backend and frontend client

slices.title: Tabular Export Engine & Analytics Summary Backend Service
slices.jtbd: When implementing report generation for this epic, I want backend services streaming XLSX and CSV exports alongside summary analytical calculations for individual plan progress and supervisor workloads, so that administrators receive rapid, accurate reports.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an export request for resident contingent in XLSX format, When processed by the reporting service, Then a formatted .xlsx workbook with institutional header styles, formulas, and auto-fitted columns is generated with HTTP 200.
Given an export request in CSV format, When processed, Then a UTF-8 encoded, RFC-4180 compliant CSV stream with BOM is returned.
Given an analytical summary request, When executed for a department, Then supervisor workload averages and individual plan completion ratios are accurately calculated.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Streaming memory footprint and workbook generation compute during large XLSX exports
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Memory consumption < 128MB during 10,000-row XLSX streaming workbook generation

slices.title: Academic Contingent & Workload Analytics Dashboard UI
slices.jtbd: When building the analytics interface for this epic, I want a responsive, accessible dashboard in high academic styling displaying summary cards, data tables, and export action triggers, so that administrators review contingent health and download reports effortlessly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an administrator viewing the analytics portal, When filtering by academic year, specialty, or supervisor, Then summary analytical cards and data grid update within 250ms with accessible ARIA live regions.
Given a user triggering XLSX or CSV export, When clicked, Then an accessible progress indicator appears and the browser automatically initiates the file download without UI freezing.
Given the visual presentation, When audited, Then austere academic styling without emojis or casual graphics is strictly maintained with WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Browser rendering speed for wide tabular contingent grids on mobile and desktop viewports
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard and contrast compliance with sub-100ms UI response to filter actions

slices.title: Multi-Format Reporting & Calculation Verification Test Suite
slices.jtbd: When verifying quality for this epic, I want unit, integration, and E2E tests validating calculation math, XLSX/CSV file syntax, and download workflows across devices, so that analytical reporting accuracy is ensured.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for the tabular export engine, When validating generated XLSX and CSV byte streams, Then MIME types, column headers, and numerical sums match expected fixtures exactly.
Given an integration test for the summary analytics service, When evaluated against synthetic student and supervisor records, Then workload balance metrics and plan progress percentages match manual baseline calculations.
Given an E2E Playwright test on mobile and desktop, When triggering a contingent XLSX export, Then the network request succeeds and the downloaded file contains valid tabular data.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Automated verification run-time for multi-format document parser test suites
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% automated test pass rate with zero regression in tabular aggregation and file export
